Package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event.client

package net.elgerelg.cozyvoicechat.api.event.client
Client-side Forge events, posted on MinecraftForge.EVENT_BUS on the physical client only.

Threads: each event documents the thread it is posted on. ClientMicrophoneEvent runs on the microphone thread and ClientReceiveAudioEvent on the playback thread; keep those listeners fast and do not touch the world from them. The rest run on the client thread.

Since:
1.1.0
